title: A Leakage-Audited, Regime-Robust Protocol for Evaluating Stock-Movement Prediction From Affective Text
description: Reproducibility package for the working paper of the same title. A leakage-audited, regime-stratified evaluation protocol for machine-learning models trained on temporal, class-imbalanced affective-text streams, demonstrated on stock-movement prediction from ~3.06 million cleaned social-media and news messages on seven U.S. mega-cap companies (2015-2023). The concept DOI always resolves to the latest version. The saved JSON/RESULTS artifacts are the single source of truth for all reported figures.
